notes.title: More Clients Await!!
notes.content:
We have updated with more side stories and hope players can enjoy and have fun! More side stories and main stories will be continuously updated in the future! Please look forward to it! In addition to the main story co-written by the player and Saku, there are currently 6 side stories available for players to experience in the game.

[list]
[*] Exposing Corrupt Politicians
[*] Unveiling the Love, Hate, and Truth Behind Memories
[*] Exploring the Reality of the "Haunted House"
[*] Remote Protection of Children in a Fire Scene
[*] Searching for the Missing Street Artist
[*] Scandal of a Famous Idol's Hidden Camera
[/list]

Solving events not only enhances Shadow Code's reputation but may also gain special "rewards", or may even meet new friends, which unlocks entirely new story arcs.
